post_text: Scam alert: We will never ask for your NetBank password or one-time code by text message. If a message feels suspicious, stop and check before clicking.
Thanks for the reminder. Nearly clicked on a fake delivery text yesterday and this made me double-check.
@CommBank I received a message saying my card is locked. Is this real? The link looks strange.
New budget habit: split your weekly spend into essentials, savings and fun money before the weekend starts.
This is actually useful. Would love a template for tracking weekly spending categories.
@CommBank app keeps timing out this morning. I need to pay rent before work.
Sorry for the trouble. Please try closing and reopening the app. If the issue continues, send us a private message so we can help.
Planning a home renovation? Compare quotes, keep a buffer for surprises and avoid transferring deposits until you verify the business.
Our small business card payment issue was sorted quickly today. Appreciate the support team calling back.
Scheduled maintenance: some card controls and notifications may be unavailable from 1:00am to 3:00am AEST on Sunday.
Thanks for giving the timing clearly. Much better than finding out during checkout.
My transfer has been pending for hours and I can't find a clear status page. Is there an outage?
Three signs a message may be a scam: urgency, unusual links and requests for codes. Pause before you respond.
Good practical reminder from @CommBank. The 'urgent action required' wording is still one of the biggest red flags.
We are supporting local community groups with grants focused on financial confidence and digital skills.
Proud to be part of this program. The digital skills sessions have already helped our clients feel safer online.
Branch wait times are rough lately. I just need a replacement card and couldn't get through on chat.
Travel tip: tell us before you go overseas and check card controls in the app before your first purchase.
Can I still use Apple Pay if my physical card is blocked while travelling?
Small business owners: join our free webinar on cash flow planning and preparing for quieter trading periods.
Would love more examples for seasonal businesses in the cash flow webinar. Retail is not the same as consulting.
We have added clearer transaction labels in the app to help you recognise subscriptions and recurring payments.
Finally! I have been trying to work out what one of my monthly charges was for ages.
Please add a way to rename merchants manually too. Some labels are still confusing.
ATM near my station has been out of service twice this week. Any update?
Start the month by checking subscriptions you no longer use. Small recurring payments can add up quickly.
The new transaction labels are helpful, but my rent payment is now showing as entertainment, which is... optimistic.
If you are buying online, use secure payment options and be cautious of sellers asking to move the conversation off-platform.
This happened to me on a marketplace sale. A checklist would be really helpful.
Locked out of NetBank after changing phones. The recovery steps are not clear.
Today we are sharing practical tips for protecting older family members from impersonation scams.
Useful consumer safety advice from @CommBank as impersonation scams continue to target older Australians.
We are trialling new in-app prompts that ask customers to pause before sending money to a first-time payee.
Good idea, but please make sure it does not slow down urgent transfers to family.
Is PayID down? Two people have tried to pay me and both transfers are stuck.
We are aware some customers are seeing delays with PayID transfers and our teams are investigating. We will share updates as soon as possible.
Know the difference between available balance and current balance before making a large purchase.
Just used the spend tracker for the first time and it was a wake-up call, in a good way.
Card controls can help if your card is misplaced. Temporarily lock, unlock or replace your card in the app.
This saved me last month. Found the card under my car seat after locking it in the app.
We are investing in energy efficiency upgrades across selected branches to reduce operational emissions.
Good, but customers also want greener lending options and clearer reporting.
The ATM locator sent me to a branch that has moved. Please update the map.
Before tax time, check that your bank statements and interest summaries are easy to access in NetBank.
Trying to download statements and the page keeps refreshing. Anyone else?
Thinking about your first credit card? Compare fees, interest rates and repayment habits before applying.
Can you make an explainer for students who are new to credit? The language is still intimidating.
Reminder: genuine bank staff will not ask you to transfer money to a 'safe account'. Stop, check and report suspicious requests.
A caller used the safe account line on my mum today. She hung up because she'd seen your post.
We are updating the app home screen to make upcoming bills and scheduled payments easier to find.
Please do not move everything again. The last redesign made regular transfers harder to find.
Credit where due: the fraud team called quickly after I reported a suspicious transfer.
Winter energy bills can be unpredictable. Build a small buffer where possible and review direct debits before they are due.
Can the app notify me before a direct debit if my balance is low? That would prevent a lot of stress.
We are celebrating teams volunteering with local partners to improve financial confidence in regional communities.
Thank you @CommBank for supporting practical financial education in our region.
If a payment request arrives unexpectedly, call the person on a trusted number before sending money.
Why is there no clear scam reporting button in the app? I had to search around for it.
Our app update includes accessibility improvements for screen readers and clearer error messages.
The clearer error messages help. Please make the font size easier to adjust too.
